:::{#sol-matadd-commutative-proof}

Both sides are $m \times n$ [matrices](#def-matrix),
so they are [equal](#def-matrix-equality) when their $(i, j)$ entries agree for every $i$ and $j$.
For each $i$ and $j$,

$$
\ba
(\matr{A} + \matr{B})_{ij}
&= a_{ij} + b_{ij}
&& \text{(@def-matrix-addition)}
\\
&= b_{ij} + a_{ij}
&& \text{(sums of numbers are symmetric)}
\\
&= (\matr{B} + \matr{A})_{ij},
&& \text{(@def-matrix-addition)}
\ea
$$

where the middle step uses [the symmetry of sums of numbers](algebra-sums.qmd#thm-sum-symmetric).
So $\matr{A} + \matr{B} = \matr{B} + \matr{A}$.

:::
